registration.if_rejected: the folder is removed and the lead is recorded as a FINDINGS entry under A2 with the same limits

question.proposition: Where an epithelium and a fibroblast share a matrix, the epithelial contribution to the fibroblast myofibroblast and collagen programme is carried by epithelial integrin alphaVbeta6 converting latent TGF-beta that is already present, rather than by epithelial supply of an EGFR ligand.
question.what_is_not_being_asked: whether integrin alphaVbeta6 activates latent TGF-beta. That is established outside this repository and is not re-asked here.
question.what_is_being_asked: the partition of the epithelial output: in one system, with the recipient's own ligand removed so the ligand arm is bounded, and with activated TGF-beta measured, does the integrin arm carry the epithelial input while the ligand arm does not.

predictions.1_direction_and_specificity: removing epithelial ITGB6 lowers the fibroblast activation programme; removing epithelial ligand supply does not, in a system where the recipient's own ligand has also been removed
predictions.2_readout: the same removal lowers activated TGF-beta at the recipient, as protein or receptor-proximal signalling, not as a transcript score
predictions.3_mediation: blocking TGF-beta receptor signalling in the recipient abolishes the epithelial ITGB6 effect

founding_observation.why_not: A15 opens with no evidence of its own; the register's own rule is that a new biological interpretation does not inherit a historical claim's status
founding_observation.endpoint: frozen five-gene fibroblast activation score: COL1A1, ACTA2, POSTN, CTHRC1, TNC, as mean log2 CPM on the well's human total

Erbb3.status: fails the culture check; composition or viability shift

limits: Fifty of the 53 plate-3 targets occupy one fixed well position in all four units; the four ITGB6 libraries are plate3-1 to plate3-4 at well C02, from the deposit's own sample titles GSM9216275, GSM9216335, GSM9216395 and GSM9216455. Target is confounded with plate position and guide pool and no randomization-based inference is available.

The ligand arm is a bounded null: the recipient fibroblasts transcribe AREG at 9.846 mean log2 CPM in 99.2 per cent of plate-3 wells, above the 7.267 the epithelial knockout removes, and the knockout is partial.
Preparation independence in this screen is unresolved, per A10 stage 1, so everything from it is a within-screen association.
The mouse Itgb6 transcript reduction is 1.138 log2 CPM, so the perturbation is partial and no arm can support absence.
The endpoint is a transcript score; TGF-beta activation was never measured.
The culture medium and matrix are not in the deposit.
The integrin is mouse and the recipient is human; cross-species activation is carried and unverified.

rivals: fibroblast-side amplification through the recipient's own alphaV integrins carries the effect
the epithelial state changes, not the activation step, since Itgb6 loss changes the epithelium in vivo
generic perturbation effects, since Erbb3 also fell
plate position or guide pool at well C02 carries the effect
well composition or read depth moves the fibroblast profile
the latent pool or the TGF-beta isoform, not the activator; the medium is not in the deposit
cross-species activation is assumed and unverified

stage_1_eligibility_gate.purpose: a later session cannot relax the readout requirement in order to get a run

conditions.1_activator_perturbed_on_the_source_cell: epithelial ITGB6 or ITGAV removed, blocked or induced, with recorded validation. An antibody dose arm is labelled as a protein perturbation and not as a genetic one.
conditions.2_more_than_one_independent_unit_and_var: at least three units per arm, where a unit is an animal, a donor or an independent preparation. A target at one fixed position in every replicate fails this condition.
conditions.3_activated_tgf_beta_measured: reporter bioassay, immunoassay specific to the active dimer, or receptor-proximal signalling in the recipient. A transcript score of TGF-beta target genes does not satisfy this condition and no pre-declared alternative exists.
conditions.4_recipient_readout_separated_from_the_s: fibroblast compartment measured on its own. A whole-tissue homogenate fails this condition.
conditions.5_ligand_arm_can_be_bounded: the recipient's own EGFR ligand is also removed, or the recipient is shown not to supply it.
conditions.6_units_established_not_assumed: if the deposit cannot say what its units are, anything computed is a within-dataset association with no claim of independent replication.

stop_rules.any_of_1_to_5_fails: the candidate does not carry the test; report the condition it failed and stop for that candidate
stop_rules.only_6_fails: stages 2 and 3 may proceed and every result is labelled descriptive

stage_1_eligibility_gate.state_on_2026_09_27: no public candidate clears conditions 3, 4 and 5 simultaneously

stage_2_freeze_invariants.unit: the animal, the donor or the independent preparation; never the well, the guide or the organoid
stage_2_freeze_invariants.primary_endpoint: activated TGF-beta at the recipient, as condition 3 defines it
stage_2_freeze_invariants.secondary_endpoint: the fibroblast activation programme, not a substitute for the primary, reused only as frozen elsewhere and without re-weighting
stage_2_freeze_invariants.mediation_arm_required: a freeze must include the recipient-side TGF-beta receptor blockade of prediction 3, or state that it does not test prediction 3
stage_2_freeze_invariants.direction_declared_in_advance: lower activated TGF-beta and a lower fibroblast programme when the epithelial activator is removed
stage_2_freeze_invariants.precise_absence: unavailable unless the perturbation is shown to be complete
stage_2_freeze_invariants.multiplicity_family: two endpoints and one mediation arm

public_data_search.conclusion: no public dataset can test the proposal; the binding gap is the absence of any deposited measurement of activated TGF-beta under an integrin perturbation

nearest_candidate.what_it_is: lung epithelial RiboTag translatome and whole lung under bleomycin, with the 3G9 anti-integrin-beta6 antibody in 4 mice against the inert antibody Axum8 in 7 mice, 48 libraries from 24 mice, day 7
nearest_candidate.bounded_use: can bound rival 2 only, by asking whether the epithelium's own programme moves under integrin beta6 blockade; not part of the staged test and never reported as one

public_data_search.caveat: keyword searches over indexed metadata; a deposit describing the same assay in different words could have been missed

prohibitions: no transcript score is called a TGF-beta activation measurement
no second endpoint on GSE307112's plate-3 wells counts as a second experiment
no claim row is added and no existing row is re-graded; the register ends at C168
no wells, guides or organoids as biological replicates
no reading of an epithelial perturbation as fibroblast causation, which is A10's prohibition in A10's words
no study note on roadmap paper 14, DOI 10.1073/pnas.2606113123, whose reading by the owner is recorded as not started, and no use of the GSE307128 series summary
no therapeutic reading in either direction
no re-asking of the established mechanism

boundaries.A2: owns amphiregulin, delivery against abundance, and the grading of the founding observation
boundaries.A9: owns the fibroblast EGFR; A15's receptor is the recipient's TGF-beta receptor
boundaries.A10: owns the organoid growth outcome and its modules; no A10 result is evidence here
